text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is the ability of computers to do tasks that normally need human intelligence, such as understanding language, recognising images, or making decisions. Machine learning is a key part of AI: instead of following fixed rules, computers learn patterns from data. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large artificial neural networks. These networks can handle very complex tasks, like speech recognition and translation. AI is already part of our daily lives. It helps us unlock our phones with our faces, suggests films on streaming services, gives us directions in maps, and even helps doctors find diseases.
